functions.name: has_permission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION inventory_private.has_permission(permission_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and exists (
    select 1 from public.users u
    where u.auth_uid = auth.uid()::text and u.active = true
      and (u.permissions ? permission_name)
  );
$function$
